title: Tensoring a short exact sequence with flat last term stays exact
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $0\to M''\xrightarrow{\ g\ }M'\xrightarrow{\ f\ }M\to0$ a short exact sequence of $R$-modules with $M$ flat [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map], and $N$ any $R$-module. Then $\mathrm{id}_N\otimes g:N\otimes_RM''\to N\otimes_RM'$ is injective, so $$0\to N\otimes_RM''\to N\otimes_RM'\to N\otimes_RM\to0$$ is exact.

mathlib_searches.query: short exact sequence 0 → M → N → P → 0 with P flat, tensor M → tensor N injective
